name: Improved Global Illumination for Volume Rendering
definition: A global illumination technique that simulates light transmission as continuous slices to produce realistic global illumination and real-time interactivity, but modifies the base method to generate soft shadows instead of hard shadows, thereby preserving local details.
summary: Improved Global Illumination for Volume Rendering simulates light transmission as continuous slices to produce realistic global illumination and soft shadows, preserving local details and enabling real-time interactivity.
